description: Copies a monophonic pitch and gate out to several polyphonic channels, for unison playing

params.text: Spreads them up to half a semitone apart, evenly either side of the input pitch; CV attenuated by the knob

inputs.text: Spreads them up to half a semitone apart, evenly either side of the input pitch; CV attenuated by the knob
The monophonic pitch copied out to every channel, at a volt per octave
The monophonic gate copied out to every channel unchanged

outputs.text: One polyphonic cable carrying the detuned copies of the input pitch
One polyphonic cable carrying the input gate on each channel

notes: with an odd number of channels, one of them keeps the pitch exactly

inputs.1: 1V per octave · continuous · one channel only
